details:
The project involves developing a geospatial intelligence technology platform that uses satellite images, geological data, remote sensing techniques, and artificial intelligence models to identify regions with potential mineral resources.

The solution aims to turn large volumes of scientific and geographic data into structured information, allowing mining companies, investors, geologists, and mineral exploration experts to investigate areas of interest more efficiently.

The platform will use data sources from scientific institutions like NASA and the United States Geological Survey (USGS), among other relevant sources. By combining and analyzing this data, the system will look to identify geological patterns, mineral changes, spectral characteristics, and land structures that might be associated with the presence of certain natural resources.

O resultado será apresentado através de mapas interactivos, indicadores de potencial mineral, coordenadas geográficas e relatórios técnicos. A plataforma não pretende substituir os métodos tradicionais de prospecção geológica, mas complementá-los, ajudando a seleccionar áreas prioritárias para investigações posteriores.

The results will be presented through interactive maps, indicators of mineral potential, geographic coordinates, and technical reports. The platform is not meant to replace traditional geological prospecting methods, but to complement them, helping to select priority areas for further investigations.
